ms.promise:
The Goal is to find partners within and outside of the Cardano Community through social media outreach, networking and promotion.
In order to achieve the following key points, we will develop an outreach and promotion program:
・Partner On-boarding: Utilizing social media outreach, networking, and promotional activities to find Partners
・Internal Collaboration: Engage within the Cardano Community to find Promo-Collaborations.
・External Collaboration and Networking: Leveraging our network of contacts beyond the Cardano ecosystem to find partners and promotion collaborations.
・Promotion: Increase visibility through targeted marketing efforts.

ms.promise:
Developing a Workshop Plan
・Define and elaborate the Workshops and experts for these workshops for the Event.

These workshops have several important purposes:
・Introduction to technologies
・Skill development
・Networking
・Feedback and support by experts

At this point, we don't know how many workshops there will be as it highly depends on the demands of each individual workshop. Also, we want to offer workshops about "hot topics" at that time, with high quality experts.

ms.promise:
Developing a Challenge Plan
・At least 3 challenges about "hot topics".
・Schedule the challenges

Key Roles of Challenges in a Hackathon:
・Focus and Direction: Clear objectives to guide participants.
・Problem-Solving: Real-world challenges inspire innovation.
・Learning and Exploration: Various topics foster exploration.
・Competition: Competitive element motivates creativity.
・Recognition and Prizes: Awards encourage active engagement.

At this point we don't know what and how many challenges there will be, and what they are about exactly as this will be outlined in the phase of preparing this milestone.

ms.promise:
Start of the Event in Berlin and post-mortem document as well as an after video.
・We will create a (360°) after video of the event and potentially also make the workshop content public (depends on the consent of the workshop experts)
・We will create a post-mortem/closing-report document to record the quantitative and qualitative success of the event
・We will create a closing video 

Key points for the post mortem/closing report:
・Attendance: Measure participant numbers.
・Project Submissions: Evaluate quantity and quality of the projects.
・Innovation: Assess creativity of the projects.
・Collaboration: Eye teamwork.
・Sponsor Engagement: Assess sponsor involvement.
・Feedback: Gather participant input.
・Impact: Assess project outcomes.
・Community Building: Evaluate networking effects.
